Ask each player whether or not they’ve heard any rumours  recently, and if so, what they’ve heard. 	 These rumours aren’t necessarily true, they’re just things  that their character has heard. It’s up to you, the Oracle, to decide  whether they’re true or not. 	 Here are some examples of things they may have heard.
